title: Scalar extension of the coefficient unit with its adjunction normalization
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l in the stated universe, and T a scheme. For every ScalarData s [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] for the actual coefficientSystemMap R_l(T) -> A_l,E(T) [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients], there exists an isomorphism from s.T applied to the integral coefficient unit to the E-coefficient unit whose adjunct, after the exact single comparison, is precisely scalarGenerator. Thus unitNormalization [def-sp-tower-class-reduction] holds. No flatness of the coefficient map or geometric hypothesis on T is required.

proof.text: The coefficient unit in degree zero is K-flat: the right tensor unitor identifies tensoring any acyclic complex with it with that same complex. Hence ScalarData.model.computes makes its universal derived counit invertible.

proof.text: Ordinary scalar extension of the unit is the target ring by multiplication s tensor a mapping to s phi(a), with inverse s mapping to s tensor one. Compose this isomorphism with the model object equality, the invertible derived counit and the standard single-complex comparisons to construct e.

proof.text: On each section the ordinary adjunct of multiplication sends x to phi(x), using ScalarData.unit_section and the pure-tensor formula for the unit isomorphism. Uniqueness in scalarGenerator_existsUnique identifies this adjunct with scalarGenerator. ScalarData.transpose_model transports the chain-level adjunct to the derived adjunct; the exact restriction single comparison cancels its factorization comparison. This gives exactly unitNormalization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalizedScalarUnit (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (s : SemilinearSections.ScalarData.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSystemMap l E T)) :
    ∃ e : s.T.obj (unit T (Rrings l T)) ≅ unit T (Arings l E T),
      unitNormalization s.T (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E T)) s.adjunction e (scalarGenerator l E T)
